rows.title: Identification details' Back link goes to Commodity details in the opening run, and template review returns to template review
rows.detail: In the opening run, Commodity details continues to Identification details when a chosen species has identifier fields, and Identification details' Back link returns to Commodity details. Today that Back link goes to the Overview. Opened from the Overview or Check your answers, the page's Back link and its save return already go back there, and they stay as they are. Opened from template review, the page's Back link and a valid save go back to template review, as the journey's other pages do.

(prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-007, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-005, repo-frontend-p6-074)

Opened from the Overview, the page's 'Back' link and 'Save and continue' on a valid page both go to the Overview; opened from Check your answers, both go to Check your answers. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-005, repo-frontend-p6-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

Combines three thin slices on the same page and the same flow entry (back link, entry into the step and skipping it, exit from the step): each needs the same flow change and the same journey walk to prove. req-201 is the live half only (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057); the germinal half belongs to the germinal-products area.

Delta only (20 Oct): main's journey foundation (EUDPA-691, #399, flow/run.js) already chains Commodity details to Identification details to Additional or Arrival details. It already skips the page when nothing needs identifying, and returns to the overview or check your answers. This row adds only the Back link (still the hub on main) and the template-review return.

The template-review halves of criteria 4 and 5 wait for the template review page (type-question-and-templates inc-156). That page is not on main and will be rebuilt from main on that theme's fresh branch. The Overview and check-your-answers halves of criterion 5 already hold on main.

The template-review return is the journey's generic entry-point rule, applied in this page's controller; it changes no file the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns (its check-answers/view-model/template-review folder), so it stays here.

Design snagging merged to main 23 Oct: the opening-run Back link mechanism this row needs is now on main. kit.runBackLink(request, stepId, current) returns the previous run step, or Overview outside the run. Each step in RUN_STEPS (live-animals flow/run.js) lists its backCandidates. Identification details deliberately has none yet, so its Back link is still Overview. Build criterion 1 by giving the animalIdentification step backCandidates [consignmentDetailsPage.id] and having its controller use kit.runBackLink. Do not add a second helper. Note that outside the opening run, kit.runBackLink falls back to Overview.

Re-analysis 27 Oct (main checked at animals-frontend ba85c222 after EUDPA-617 c3183a8e): partly met. The Overview and Check your answers halves of criterion 5 hold on main (kit.runBackLink falls back to the overview outside the run, shared/kit.js:241-254; kit.nextTarget returns to the overview or review, kit.js:222-228), so they are now a regression guard. The unmerged commodities-and-reason branch adds a second Back-link map (RUN_BACK_STEPS) to run.js: whichever lands second reconciles the two.

rows.title: An empty species panel is refused on its own save, even beside a filled one
rows.detail: One identifier is enough to save a live animal, but an animal with no identifier at all is not a record. Today 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal' fires only when nothing is typed anywhere on the page, so with two species an empty panel's save is skipped silently while the other's data is there. The check moves to each panel: a panel save with every identifier of its current animal blank is refused on that panel. The page's own 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview' still never block on missing identifiers, and the page still shows no message about the submit rule.
acceptanceCriteria: With cattle and dogs on the page, an ear tag typed into the cattle panel and nothing typed into the dog panel, pressing the dog panel's 'Save and add another' saves nothing and shows 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal' in the 'There is a problem' summary and inline on the dog panel's first identifier field; the summary link focuses that field. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p5-019; conflicts:c-042)

Pressing 'Save and finish' on a species' last animal still to enter, with every identifier of that animal blank, is refused the same way and the animal stays to enter. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-027; conflicts:c-042)
A partly filled animal, with one identifier given and the rest blank, saves with no error and is listed in that panel's saved-animals table. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-019; conflicts:c-042)

Pressing the page's 'Save and continue' or 'Save and return to overview' with every identifier blank saves no animal, shows no error and takes the trader on. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-028; conflicts:c-042)

rows.title: Every selected species has an identification panel, and a species with no specific identifier is asked for identification details and a description
rows.detail: Today the page asks only about commodity lines whose commodity declares at least one identifier type: a line such as Atlantic salmon is listed in the 'Selected commodities' summary but gets no panel and no fields, so its animals cannot be identified at all. The notification data specification gives every such species two free-text answers instead, 'Identification details' and 'Description', each optional and at most 58 characters, so every selected species has a panel and some way of identifying its animals. Both values are stored on the animal record and read back when the page is reopened.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Selected commodities' summary on Identification details lists a row for every commodity line on the consignment, and every selected species below it has an identification panel of its own. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-060; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-035; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-007, repo-frontend-p6-094; conflicts:c-333)

A selected species whose commodity asks for none of passport, tattoo, ear tag or horse name is asked for 'Identification details' and 'Description' in its panel, in that order; an Atlantic salmon line is such a species today. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-046, confluence-6497338582-p4-054, confluence-6497338582-p4-060, confluence-6497338582-p4-061; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-008; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p6-017; conflicts:c-333)

'Identification details' and 'Description' are each a text input 20 characters wide, with the field label and no hint. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-044, confluence-6497338582-p4-052; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-024; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-017)

Both answers are optional: a panel with 'Identification details' filled and 'Description' blank saves the animal, and so does the other way round. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-049, confluence-6497338582-p4-057)

An 'Identification details' value of 59 characters shows 'Identification details must be 58 characters or less' in the error summary and inline on the field, and a value of 58 characters saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-045; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028)

A 'Description' value of 59 characters shows 'Description must be 58 characters or less' in the error summary and inline on the field, and a value of 58 characters saves. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p4-053; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028)

An animal saved from such a panel is listed in that panel's saved-animals table, whose columns are 'Animal', 'Identification details' and 'Description', with a 'Remove' action on each row. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-085, repo-frontend-p6-086, repo-frontend-p6-090)

rows.title: Pressing Enter in an identification field removes no animal and reaches no hidden button
rows.detail: Today one hidden 'Save and finish' submit button sits at the top of the whole form and is the default submit for every field on the page, whichever species panel the field belongs to. With a panel per species, and a 'Remove' button on every saved animal, that single default submit is the wrong owner for a field: the default submit a field presses belongs to the panel the field is in, and it is never a panel's 'Remove' action or another panel's save. The trader keeps every animal they have already saved, and a keyboard or screen-reader user meets no button inside a panel that is not one of the panel's own.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing Enter in an identifier field of a species panel that already has saved animals leaves every one of those animals listed in that panel's saved-animals table, and leaves every other panel's saved animals listed too. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-076, repo-frontend-p6-090, repo-frontend-p6-091; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-019)

The buttons a keyboard or screen-reader user reaches inside a species panel are that panel's own save button and a 'Remove' action for each animal it has saved; tabbing forward from the panel's last identifier field reaches one of those next. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-067, repo-frontend-p6-068, repo-frontend-p6-076, repo-frontend-p6-090)
The Identification details page passes its accessibility checks with a species panel open and animals saved in it. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-101)

rows.title: Pigs, sheep and goats are identified by ear tag only
rows.detail: Pigs (0103), sheep (010410) and goats (010420) are identified per animal by 'Ear tag' only. The live-animal catalogue reaches the service from master data management, and the commodity integration that brings these three in is not this programme's to build, so the row waits for it. Once they are offered, each selected pig, sheep or goat species gets a panel asking for one ear tag per animal.
acceptanceCriteria: A selected pig species (0103) gets a panel asking for 'Ear tag' and no other identifier, once per animal. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-017)
A selected sheep (010410) or goat (010420) species gets a panel asking for 'Ear tag' and no other identifier, once per animal. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-021)

A pig, sheep or goat saved with an ear tag is listed in its saved-animals table, which has an 'Animal' column, an 'Ear tag' column and a 'Remove' action. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-017, prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-021)
openQuestions: Blocked until commodities come from master data management: pigs (0103), sheep (010410) and goats (010420) join the live-animals catalogue only through the commodity integration, which this programme cannot build. Whoever owns that integration must deliver it, and Sam must rule the catalogue unblocked, before this row can be built (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 28, 29 and 32).

rows.title: The permanent address leaves the identification page
rows.detail: Today the cards for species that need a permanent address (cats, dogs and ferrets) carry a fraud warning, a permanent-address definition, the question 'Where will their permanent address be?' and eight address fields under the identifiers, validate them all-or-nothing, store the address on each animal and show it as a 'Permanent address' column. Each animal's permanent address is asked on its own permanent address page with the consignment's other parties, so it leaves this page with its validation, its table column and its storage from here.
acceptanceCriteria: A cat, dog or ferret panel on Identification details asks only for that species' identifiers: its content is the identifier fields, the panel's save button and its saved-animals table. rows.title: Germinal identification dates are single text inputs, with the data specification's date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal products set's copy of the identification page, the collection and production dates are each a single text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026', which works without JavaScript. No range rule applies to either date, and the production date is not checked against the collection date. A date in the wrong form, a date that is not real, and an identification number or mark over 58 characters are each refused with their own message, in the error summary and inline on the field.

rows.title: Germinal identification counts packages, not animals, in its selected commodities summary
rows.detail: The germinal products set's copy of the identification page summarises the consignment's selected commodities, as the live-animals page does, but a germinal consignment is counted in packages. Its quantity column is headed 'Number of packages' and shows each species' saved count, where the live-animals page keeps 'Number of animals'.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal products identification page, the 'Selected commodities' quantity column is headed 'Number of packages' and shows each species' saved number of packages. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-067; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)
On the live-animals identification page, that column is still headed 'Number of animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-036; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p6-095)
